Olivia: Quick poll: midday micro — 15-min parkour-ish agility circuit around the courtyard or 15-min guided mindfulness on the roof? :running: :seedling:
Samir: Parkour for me. My coordination is a spectacle. :sweat_smile:
Jorge: Mindfulness. My brain needs a timeout. Also I will nap afterwards. :zzz:
Mina: Can we compromise: do the agility circuit but finish with 3-min breath-down? :raised_hands:
Olivia: That could work. Rule: if it drizzles we move the circuit to the indoor gym and do step-ups instead.
wellness-bot: Event created: "Courtyard Agility vs Rooftop Mindfulness" 12:15 tomorrow. Optional.
Samir: Stakes? Loser makes tea for the squad on Friday? :tea:
Jorge: Fine. But if mindfulness wins, the winner chooses the playlist for Monday standup. :musical_note:
Mina: RSVP: mindfulness (but bringing a tiny yoga mat just in case). 
Olivia: RSVP: agility. I'll bring cones and a whistle (low volume). 
Samir: RSVP: agility. Will provide dramatic encouragement noises.
wellness-bot: Reminder: please stretch before agility and bring a water bottle. Respect capacity limits on the roof.
Olivia: OK see y'all tomorrow. May the chillest person win. :sparkles:
